facts.fact: Speaker Saara Kuugongelwa-Amadhila said Namibia is finalising a Draft Artificial Intelligence Bill to guide ethical AI deployment and a Cybercrime Bill to address digital threats including AI misuse.

NAM.note: AI tools for Parliament (chatbots, transcription) are only under consideration; no pilot or test is stated.

facts.fact: The Speaker of the National Assembly said Namibia is finalising a Draft Artificial Intelligence Bill.

NAM.note: No AI tool in a public sector system is stated.
The Speaker speaks of the introduction of a National AI Strategy without saying whether it is adopted or in draft.
No AI model, dataset or computing built in Namibia is stated.

facts.fact: The Speaker of the National Assembly said Namibia is finalising a Cybercrime Bill to address digital threats.
The Speaker of the National Assembly said Namibia is finalising a Data Protection Bill to ensure personal privacy and data security.
